title: Flowmap run document
description: Evidence for one instance of a flow: node statuses, extracted fields, log evidence and the transitions taken. Generated by the matching engine (or written by hand as a scrubbed fixture); never committed with real logs.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL, for JSON files that want editor autocomplete.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Only 1 exists.
schemaVersion.x-message: must be 1, the only schema version this validator understands

flow.description: Name of the flow this run was matched against (the `flow` field of the flow file).

flowRevision.description: Which version of the flow file the run was matched against, for example git:3f2a9c1.

correlation.description: The correlation key and value that identify this instance, for example { "orderId": "4821" }.

generatedAt.description: When the run document was produced.

nodes.description: Evidence per node id. A flow node left out is treated as not reached.

unexpected.description: Transitions seen in the logs that the flow does not declare: the conformance gaps.

identifier.x-message: must be lowercase kebab-case (letters, digits and single hyphens), for example payment-retry

eventName.x-message: must be an event name such as payment.declined (letters, digits and _ . : -)

timestamp.x-message: must be an ISO 8601 timestamp with a time zone, for example 2026-10-31T09:03:00Z

status.x-message: must be one of success, failure, pending, not_reached

fields.description: Values extracted by the node's evidence.display rules: label -> value.

evidence.description: The log lines behind this node, oldest first.

msg.description: Short human-readable text for the timeline, for example Card declined.

ref.x-message: must be a reference URI to the raw log line, for example loki://payments-api?id=abc123
ref.description: Points back to the raw log line; the scheme depends on the adapter (file://, loki://, otel://).

raw.description: The log line itself, as the backend or file held it, so the evidence can be read without opening the source. May contain personal data: runs with raw lines are never committed except as scrubbed fixtures.

label.description: The label of the declared edge, to tell parallel edges apart.

observed.description: How many times the instance took this transition.

ref.x-message: must be a reference URI to the raw log line, for example loki://inventory?id=ghi789
ref.description: Points back to the log line that revealed the transition.

raw.description: The log line that revealed the transition, as the backend or file held it.
